info.name: Swish Analytics Sportsbook ATP Tennis NCAA Basketball API

params.name: game
params.description: The ID value(s) of the event(s) for which you are requesting market data.

params.name: date
params.description: The EST date(s) of the event(s) for which you are requesting market data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: optimal
params.description: Can be used to request markets classified as optimal (true) or not optimal (false)

params.name: lineType
params.description: Can be used to request only fraction lines or integer lines.

params.name: stat
params.description: The ID value(s) of the statistic(s) for which you are requesting data.

params.name: modifiedAtMicroGreater
params.description: The UTC timestamp(s) denoting when a market was last updated with new data in micro seconds to be used to request all markets that have been updated at or after the timestamp passed in. Value passed in should always be the max modifiedAtMicro from the most recent payload received

params.name: game
params.description: The ID value of the event(s) for which you are requesting schedule data.

params.name: stat
params.description: The ID value(s) of the statistic(s) for which you are requesting data.

params.name: lineType
params.description: Can be used to request only fraction lines or integer lines. Accepts only fraction or integer as values

params.name: wasBalanced
params.description: Can be used to request markets that were previously classified as balanced (true) or were not previously classified as balanced (false). Accepts only true or false as values

params.name: modifiedAtMicroGreater
params.description: The UTC timestamp(s) denoting when a market was last updated with new data in micro seconds to be used to request all markets that have been updated at or after the timestamp passed in. Value passed in should always be the max modifiedAtMicro from the most recent payload received

params.name: milestone
params.description: Can be used to request only those markets classified as milestone lines (true) or not classified as milestone lines (false). Accepts only true or false as values
